stories.tldr: ESPN and Fanatics Studios announced the second edition of Fanatics Fest: All Access, an hour-long special premiering August 4 at 7 p.m. ET on ESPN. Hosted by NBA star Karl-Anthony Towns and media personality Jordyn Woods, the special offers behind-the-scenes access to the summer's premier sports and entertainment event, featuring appearances from WWE Superstars Rhea Ripley, Roman Reigns, and Liv Morgan alongside major athletes and celebrities.

stories.title: WWE Stars and Ryan Garcia RAW appearance
stories.tldr: Boxer Ryan Garcia made a controversial appearance on WWE RAW on July 27, 2026, where he attacked Joe Hendry during an in-ring concert segment and aligned with Dominik Mysterio. According to reports, several WWE Superstars internally wanted nothing to do with Garcia due to his history of racial comments and other controversies.

stories.title: CM Punk vs Cody Rhodes at SummerSlam
stories.tldr: CM Punk successfully retained the Undisputed WWE Championship against Cody Rhodes at SummerSlam, but the finish was marred by Randy Orton's shocking return, who attacked Rhodes with an RKO while the referee was down. Punk also addressed not main eventing the show, insisting he doesn't need contract provisions guaranteeing the closing match and claiming "CM Punk is ALWAYS the main event." Additionally, Punk reflected on the significance of defending his title on the 20th anniversary of his WWE television debut.

stories.title: Oba Femi defeats Brock Lesnar at SummerSlam
stories.tldr: After Oba Femi defeated Brock Lesnar in the SummerSlam main event Hell in a Cell match, Lesnar publicly declared Femi "the future of WWE" while calling himself "the past." Femi also fired back at CM Punk's post-show comments, telling the champion that his "pipebombs" don't work against him.

stories.title: Nick Aldis WWE future and SmackDown GM role
stories.tldr: Nick Aldis handed Triple H a resignation letter after his SummerSlam loss to Gunther, but Triple H tore it up and reinstated him as SmackDown General Manager. At the post-show press conference, Triple H said "never say never" about Aldis wrestling again, acknowledging that the competitor's desire never truly dies despite years away from the ring.

stories.title: Randy Orton returns at SummerSlam
stories.tldr: Orton interfered in CM Punk's SummerSlam title defense against Rhodes, hitting an RKO that allowed Punk to retain. Alternate footage captured Kim Orton running through the crowd behind her husband during his dramatic return. WWE capitalized immediately, releasing new Orton merchandise within minutes of his appearance.

stories.title: Liv Morgan retains Women's Championship
stories.tldr: Liv Morgan successfully defended her Women's World Championship against IYO SKY at SummerSlam, winning with consecutive finishers in a physical match that left her with a visible black eye. Morgan posted on social media afterward showing off the injury while confidently dismissing any concern. The champion also indicated she won't defend the title again for approximately another 100 days.

stories.title: GUNTHER defeats Nick Aldis
stories.tldr: GUNTHER defeated Nick Aldis at SummerSlam Night One via submission, extending his undefeated non-title singles record to 38-0. Aldis put up a strong fight with impressive moves including a superplex and flying elbows, but ultimately tapped out to the sleeper hold. The crowd gave Aldis a standing ovation despite the loss, and he celebrated with his wife Mickie James and their son.

stories.title: Kevin Owens return speculation
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens was spotted in Minneapolis during SummerSlam weekend and has been training at the WWE Performance Center this week, signaling his return is imminent. Backstage reports indicate he is "very close" to returning and is expected to join WWE SmackDown when he does. His presence at the event and recent training activity suggest a potential in-ring return could happen very soon.

stories.title: Grayson Waller takes shots at TNA on NXT
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller's TNA shots on NXT have drawn responses from both Matt Hardy and Nic Nemeth. Hardy suggested the comments might signal WWE-TNA collaboration while noting the mention benefits TNA regardless, while Nemeth challenged Waller to back up his words and reminded him he was demoted to NXT for failing on the main roster.

stories.title: Dragon Lee injury update
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee confirmed the torn thumb is specifically a collateral ligament tear and has been advised by doctors not to compete. He's been pulled from AAA's Verano de Escándalo event, with Lince Dorado replacing him in a Latin American Championship qualifier. There is currently no confirmed return timeline.

stories.title: Sol Ruca discusses Triple H meeting after title loss
stories.tldr: Triple H personally reassured Sol Ruca after her title loss, telling her the change wasn't due to any performance issues on her part. Ruca also discussed the adjustment to main roster life, noting that NXT provided a lower-risk environment to develop her character and collaborate creatively with others, whereas the main roster puts more pressure and responsibility on performers to shape their own personas.

stories.title: Jeff Cobb seeks more opportunities in WWE
stories.tldr: Cobb actively lobbied WWE for expanded opportunities during his final months, specifically requesting Main Event appearances and dark match slots to showcase his wrestling abilities. He acknowledged being passive early in his tenure but grew frustrated as he realized his role was limiting his visibility compared to other Bloodline members. While crediting himself for maximizing limited opportunities, Cobb admitted both he and WWE could have done more to develop his character.

stories.title: Chad Gable commends Ludwig Kaiser for AAA appearance
stories.tldr: During his podcast appearance, Chad Gable praised Ludwig Kaiser for transforming the El Grande Americano character into something that resonates with audiences following Kaiser's victory in their AAA match last May. Gable acknowledged initially taking issue with Kaiser assuming the identity he created, but credited him for elevating it to new heights. Kaiser continues performing as El Grande Americano in AAA, while Gable has moved on to challenge Penta for the Intercontinental Championship at SummerSlam.

stories.title: Zoey Stark discusses WWE release
stories.tldr: Zoey Stark revealed she had a premonition about her WWE release, sensing something was wrong in the weeks before receiving the call while recovering from knee surgery. She's now competing as Zoey Serrano on the independent circuit, including a recent RevPro appearance where she reunited with Shayna Baszler for a tag team victory.

stories.title: Nikki Bella discusses Brie's return impact
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella revealed that her planned heel turn was scrapped when Brie returned at the 2026 Royal Rumble, forcing WWE to pivot toward reuniting the Bella Twins instead. Nikki had been actively requesting the heel role and was thriving in the character before the creative change forced her into a neutral position on Raw in Philadelphia.

stories.title: La Parka qualifies for AAA Triplemania
stories.tldr: La Parka has qualified for the Fatal Four-Way match for the vacant AAA Latin American Championship at Triplemania 34 by defeating Mecha Wolf and Lince Dorado on August 1, 2026, during the second night of AAA Verano de Escandalo. He joins El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. in the championship match, with additional qualifying matches still to be completed to fill out the four-way bout.

stories.title: CMLL Leyenda de Plata and title matches
stories.tldr: CMLL held a major event on Friday, July 31, 2026 at Arena Mexico featuring the Leyenda de Plata tournament final won by Mascara Dorada, three championship matches, and a preview of the upcoming Aniversario lucha de apuesta matches. Thunder Rosa won the Mexican National Women's Championship, Persephone retained her CMLL Women's World Championship against Tessa Blanchard, and Hechicero successfully defended the CMLL World Heavyweight Championship against Roderick Strong.

stories.title: Bret Hart praises protégé Mo Jabari
stories.tldr: Bret Hart recently praised his protégé Mo Jabari during an appearance on MLP Mayhem, highlighting Jabari's impressive background as a refugee who fled Kenya and settled in Canada. Jabari, who competes for Dungeon Wrestling in Calgary, has become one of the top young stars on the Western Canadian independent scene and has worked internationally including appearances for AEW and in Japan.

stories.title: AAA Verano de Escandalo 2026
stories.tldr: AAA Verano de Escandalo 2026 is a multi-night event running from July 25 to August 8, with night two airing on FOX this Saturday, August 1 at 10pm ET. The card features AAA World Cruiserweight Champion Fenix facing Mini Vikingo and a three-way qualifier for the vacant AAA Latin American Championship featuring Psycho Clown, El Fiscal, and Cruz del Toro. A comprehensive worldwide broadcast time guide has been provided for viewers across all major time zones.

stories.title: TNA worst reveal in history
stories.tldr: TNA heavily promoted a mystery debut on August 1, 2013, that turned out to be MMA star Tito Ortiz, a move that backfired spectacularly with both wrestling and MMA fans. The reveal generated almost no crowd reaction, with many fans not even recognizing Ortiz due to his changed appearance, and the angle was widely criticized as a failed attempt to cross-promote with Bellator MMA's upcoming fight card.

stories.title: Title changes on August 1st
stories.tldr: August 1st has historically been a major day for professional wrestling title changes, with approximately 230 significant title changes occurring on this date throughout wrestling history. Notable champions crowned on this day include legendary figures like Harley Race, Atlantis, and more recently MJF, along with multiple tag team and trios championship victories spanning from 1975 through 2025.

stories.title: Road To Back In The Saddle documentary
stories.tldr: Gaston LaRue discovered professional wrestling as a path forward after feeling lost following high school graduation. Under trainers Eric Draven and Van Martigan, he evolved from a comedic "Mr. By the Book" character into "The Mozart of Professional Wrestling," a technically driven performer obsessed with treating each match as a refined artistic composition.

stories.title: WWE Star Injured At SummerSlam 2026
stories.tldr: Brie Bella suffered a shoulder injury during the six-woman tag team match at WWE SummerSlam 2026 on August 1, with Triple H confirming she was hospitalized for scans. In separate comments, Triple H addressed talent frustrations about the same wrestlers holding top positions, stating that wrestlers must earn their spots through fan support rather than tenure alone.

stories.title: CM Punk Reacts To Not Being SummerSlam Main Event Match With Confident Statement
stories.tldr: CM Punk retained his Undisputed WWE Championship at SummerSlam 2026 with help from Randy Orton's return, but his match was not the event's main event. In a post-show interview, Punk responded confidently to questions about not headlining, stating that while he had feelings about it, he doesn't need contractual main event guarantees and considers himself "always the main event" regardless of card placement.

stories.title: Daughter of Triple H & Stephanie McMahon sings ‘God Bless America’ at WWE SummerSlam
stories.tldr: Vaughn Evelyn, the youngest daughter of Triple H and Stephanie McMahon, made her official WWE television debut by singing "God Bless America" at the opening of WWE SummerSlam 2026. The performance continued WWE's tradition of having celebrity singers perform the patriotic song before their major premium live events, with Darius Rucker scheduled to perform on Night Two of the event.

stories.title: Big Heel Turn At WWE SummerSlam 2026, Possible Injury Late In The Show
stories.tldr: The Bellas executed a shocking heel turn at WWE SummerSlam 2026, attacking Paige after their six-woman tag team loss and revealing their jealousy over her capturing the Women's Tag Team Championships in Nikki's absence. Nikki marked her return from a three-month ankle injury by hitting Paige with the Rack Attack 2.0 while shouting "no one takes my spot," and Brie appeared to suffer a shoulder injury during the angle.

stories.title: Brock Lesnar Named to University of Minnesota’s 2026 Hall of Fame Class
stories.tldr: Brock Lesnar has been named to the University of Minnesota's 2026 M Club Hall of Fame class following his dominant two-year college wrestling career from 1998 to 2000. Lesnar compiled a 55-3 record with 23 pins, won the 2000 NCAA heavyweight championship, and finished as runner-up in 1999. The induction ceremony takes place on October 2 at Huntington Bank Stadium, with Lesnar also being recognized during the Gophers' home football game against Michigan on October 3.

stories.title: Triple H & Stephanie McMahon’s Daughter Makes WWE TV Debut In The Ring At SummerSlam 2026
stories.tldr: Vaughn Evelyn Levesque, the daughter of Triple H and Stephanie McMahon, made her official WWE television debut at SummerSlam 2026 by performing the national anthem. The performance opened the premium live event and was later shared on WWE's social media accounts. While she has occasionally appeared at WWE events with her parents in the past, this marked her first official televised appearance for the company.

stories.title: ROH Death Before Dishonor challengers
stories.tldr: ROH has finalized three additional championship matches for Death Before Dishonor on August 21. Nick Wayne will challenge Bandido for the ROH World Championship, Hazuki from Stardom will face Athena for the Women's World Championship, and Steph De Lander will challenge Deonna Purrazzo for the Women's Pure Championship.

stories.title: TNA wrestling tournament partnership
stories.tldr: TNA's :30 Second Takedown tournament will premiere immediately after Bound For Glory on October 11 at 7 p.m. EST on TNA+. The 32-wrestler tournament uses a card-draw format to determine matchups, with each bout lasting 30 seconds. George Veras will oversee production while Rich Christensen hosts.

stories.title: Road Dogg TNA status update
stories.tldr: Road Dogg's negotiations to join TNA's creative team have stalled, and the two parties are not currently close to an agreement. The Hall of Famer was expected to sign with the promotion in June and even appeared backstage at Slammiversary, but talks have since hit a roadblock. TNA's creative department recently underwent restructuring following Tommy Dreamer's June departure.

stories.title: AEW Redemption Tony Khan ALS Challenge
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan completed the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge after being nominated by Sting, raising awareness and support for Rebel (Tanea Brooks), who is battling ALS. Khan promoted AEW's Rebel Heart fundraiser, a special Dynamite episode on September 9 in Athens, Georgia, where AEW will donate to I Am ALS and the Team Gleason Foundation. Khan also nominated Jacksonville Jaguars head coach Liam Coen and executives to participate in the challenge.

stories.title: Will Ospreay AEW Involvement
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay is promoting AEW's All In event at Wembley Stadium on August 30, where he will challenge Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship. The AEW star is attempting to attract lapsed fans from the WWE Attitude Era by emphasizing how professional wrestling has evolved athletically and culturally since that era. Ospreay believes wrestling has become more inclusive and presented in a sports environment, and points to his match against Bryan Danielson at Dynasty 2024 as an example of the high-quality storytelling modern wrestling offers.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Viewership Report
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite drew 676,000 viewers on Wednesday, down 4.3% from the previous week and marking its lowest audience since July 1st. The show posted a 0.12 demo rating, tying its third-best performance since April 8th, while facing competition from a WNBA game and Shark Week programming that dominated cable viewership.

stories.title: AEW All In London 2026 Ticket Sales
stories.tldr: AEW All In London 2026 at Wembley Stadium has sold 35,253 tickets so far, making it the third largest crowd in AEW history. The event is 18,000 tickets away from matching the 2024 London show's 45,000 attendance, with Kenny Omega vs. Will Ospreay for the AEW World Championship serving as the main event draw. Ticket sales reportedly jumped 9,000 seats following Omega's recent title victory over MJF.

stories.title: AEW Fan Criticism Commentary
stories.tldr: A wrestling news editor expresses frustration with AEW's expanding show lengths and excessive content volume, arguing that while the promotion's in-ring quality is excellent, the constant need for longer broadcasts and packed cards makes covering the product feel overwhelming rather than enjoyable, especially when compared to the total weekly wrestling hours fans are expected to consume.

stories.title: Booker T Praises AEW Star Maya World
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Booker T praised AEW star Maya World following her TBS Championship victory over Hikaru Shida at AEW Redemption. World, who previously wrestled for Booker's Reality of Wrestling promotion, has quickly risen through AEW's ranks and successfully defended her newly won title on AEW Dynamite with assistance from Kris Statlander.

stories.title: AEW Redemption Event Coverage
stories.tldr: Jacques Rougeau's backstage tantrum at AEW Redemption over a rejected tribute video has now been disputed by those close to the Rougeau Brothers, who claim he understood the situation and there was no eviction threat. The Rougeaus' people acknowledged AEW's strict "No AI" policy prevented the video from airing, but disputed the severity of Rougeau's reaction.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns AEW Debut
stories.tldr: Behind-the-scenes sources indicate AEW was always expected to outbid TNA for the Motor City Machine Guns, with no surprise in the industry about their eventual signing. Chris Sabin called the Detroit debut one of his all-time favorite career moments, while New Day's free agency is expected to further bolster AEW's tag team division.

stories.title: AEW Redemption Jacques Rougeau Incident
stories.tldr: Jacques Rougeau reportedly had an angry confrontation with AEW officials backstage at the Redemption PPV after a video package he submitted for the Rougeau Family ceremony couldn't be used. The video was too long, contained unlicensed music and material, and included AI-generated elements that AEW rejected. An AEW official allegedly told Rougeau to calm down or face removal from the building.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown 7/31/2026 Episode Coverage
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown on July 31, 2026 from Green Bay, Wisconsin served as the go-home show for SummerSlam, featuring Lash Legend defeating Giulia in a two-minute squash to qualify for the interim Women's World Championship ladder match, while WWE legend Haku made a surprise return to align with sons Tama and Talla Tonga after they attacked both tag team championship teams in a title-for-title match that ended in disqualification.

stories.title: Kevin Owens and Randy Orton WWE Return Status
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens and Randy Orton are both expected to return to WWE very soon, with Orton potentially back within the next week. Owens has been out since early 2025 following neck fusion surgery, while Orton has been absent since losing to Cody Rhodes at WrestleMania 42, despite previously claiming he was just taking time off. Both stars are likely to be inserted into major championship programs upon their returns.

stories.title: WWE Personal News and Wellness
stories.tldr: Mandy Rose and Tino Sabbatelli have welcomed their first child together, marking a new chapter in their lives after their respective WWE departures. In other personal news, John Cena has undergone a second hair transplant procedure as he continues his entertainment career transition, while Batista revealed he was taking $300 loans even after becoming WWE World Champion due to financial hardships from the touring schedule.

stories.title: CM Punk WWE Championship Run and Personal Stories
stories.tldr: CM Punk credited his enduring emotional connection with WWE fans to his authenticity combined with the "currency" he has built over decades in the wrestling business. Speaking on Busted Open Radio ahead of his SummerSlam championship defense against Cody Rhodes, Punk discussed his biggest influences, his memorable rivalry with Drew McIntyre, and why turning fans against him would be difficult despite his skill at manipulating audience emotions.

stories.title: Kurt Angle Olympic Gold Medal Anniversary
stories.tldr: Kurt Angle celebrated the 30th anniversary of winning Olympic gold on July 31, 2026, reflecting on defeating Abbas Jadidi at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics while competing with a broken neck. The WWE Hall of Famer emphasized that discipline beats excuses and encouraged aspiring athletes to chase their dreams, stating he would make the same choice again if given the opportunity.

stories.title: Jeff Cobb WWE Stint and Career
stories.tldr: Jeff Cobb's nearly year-long WWE run with the Bloodline was a childhood dream realized, but fell short of expectations with only 19 televised matches and creative decisions he disagreed with, including a forced gimmick change to facepaint and a name change from Jeff Cobb to JC Mateo that confused him after being called by his real name on commentary.

stories.title: Chad Gable and Cody Rhodes Podcast Discussion
stories.tldr: During his What Do You Wanna Talk About? podcast with Chad Gable, Cody Rhodes discussed two main topics: Gable's regrets about the Shorty G gimmick, which he partially attributed to Eric Bischoff, and Rhodes's strong defense of The Miz's wrestling abilities against fan criticism. Rhodes emphasized that wrestlers who have proven themselves once can do so again, and criticized anyone who questions Miz's in-ring talent.

stories.title: Joe Gacy Wyatt Sicks and Bray Wyatt
stories.tldr: Joe Gacy revealed that Bray Wyatt originally wanted to work with him in NXT before the Wyatt Sicks faction was created, with this being communicated to him by WWE's Rob Fee shortly after Wyatt's passing in August 2023. Gacy also identified the group's first major misstep as being sidelined when Bo Dallas (Uncle Howdy) suffered an injury, as WWE creative didn't develop the other members enough to carry the faction independently during his absence.

stories.title: Second-Generation Wrestlers at WWE Events
stories.tldr: Avery Styles, son of WWE legend A.J. Styles, made his Game Changer Wrestling debut on July 31, defeating Alex Lev with the spiral tap—A.J.'s original TNA finisher. The younger Styles impressed fans by executing his father's signature moves, and will next face Marcus Mathers at GCW Rude Awakening on August 1 in Minneapolis.

stories.title: WWE Releases and Departures
stories.tldr: Veronica West, a 22-year-old wrestler who competed in WWE's ID program under the name Veronica Haven, has announced her departure from the company. After less than three years in the wrestling industry and just a few months in the WWE ID initiative, West is moving forward with her wrestling career while also pursuing other interests in singing, songwriting, and acting. She expressed gratitude for her time at the Performance Center and the opportunities she gained, including competing on Evolve.

stories.title: Gunther WWE Championship Pursuit
stories.tldr: GUNTHER addressed questions about whether his recent feuds with Sami Zayn and Nick Aldis have derailed his WWE Championship pursuit, explaining that while winning the top title is every wrestler's ultimate goal, success in wrestling extends beyond constantly chasing gold. He emphasized the importance of special occasion matches like his encounters with Goldberg, Cena, and AJ Styles, viewing them as equally meaningful opportunities to entertain audiences and build his legacy before facing Aldis at SummerSlam 2026.

stories.title: Brie Bella WWE Memory and Stephanie McMahon
stories.tldr: Brie Bella recently recalled how her memorable 2014 "I Quit" segment with Stephanie McMahon nearly went off the rails when Vince McMahon suggested last-minute script changes in Gorilla Position. Rather than memorize another rewritten script, Stephanie improvised by simply asking questions and having Bella and Bryan Danielson answer naturally, resulting in one of WWE's most iconic moments. Both Bella and McMahon praised how the segment came together organically despite the backstage chaos.

stories.title: Bella Twins Future Goals and Legacy
stories.tldr: The Bella Twins are discussing their remaining career goals in WWE, including winning the tag titles together as a team and pursuing additional championship runs. Beyond championships, Brie expressed interest in trying stipulation matches like ladder matches and Hell in a Cell. The twins also reflected on how the term "Diva" has evolved from a stigmatized label during the women's revolution to something that now represents confidence and equality in modern WWE.

stories.title: Finn Balor WWE Title Aspirations
stories.tldr: Finn Balor expressed confidence that he is now better prepared to become WWE World Champion than he was a decade ago when he won the inaugural Universal Championship. The veteran performer credits ten years of experience, personal growth, and increased mental and physical preparedness for his renewed championship aspirations. Balor is currently competing on SmackDown and faces Sami Zayn in a No. 1 Contender match at SummerSlam for the Undisputed WWE Championship.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam Attendance and Venue Updates
stories.tldr: A group of fans breached security at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis and gained unauthorized access to the SummerSlam ring setup during overnight crew preparations. Video footage captured them walking through restricted areas, including past a surveillance room, before one fan climbed into the ring around 2:36 a.m. The incident raises serious security concerns for both WWE and the venue ahead of the August 1-2 event.

stories.title: Vince McMahon and WWE Civil Matters
stories.tldr: Wrestling fans who are calling for Vince McMahon's return to WWE/TKO are hypocritical given they spent the 2010s criticizing his creative decisions as "obsolete" and "out of touch." While McMahon has settled his legal issues with Janel Grant and other matters, the real problem with WWE isn't the creative team under Triple H, who has actually increased revenue over the past five years, but rather corporate interference from Endeavor executives who prioritize price gouging fans and pushing talent represented by their WME agency.

stories.title: The Undertaker Career Retrospective
stories.tldr: The Undertaker recently revealed on his podcast that a dream match between him and Sting never happened because Vince McMahon didn't want to pursue it, despite both wrestlers being eager to compete and fans clamoring for the bout. Undertaker expressed bewilderment over the decision, calling it a "home run" and "the biggest miss of a WrestleMania," while acknowledging he never had an in-depth conversation with McMahon about why the match was rejected.

stories.title: Netflix Edits Brock Lesnar WWE RAW Segment
stories.tldr: Netflix has edited out middle finger gestures from a WWE RAW segment featuring Brock Lesnar and Oba Femi ahead of their Hell in a Cell match at SummerSlam 2026. The streaming platform removes edgier content from RAW replays to maintain the show's TV-PG rating, with recent examples including obscuring Cody Rhodes' blood after a GUNTHER attack. The highly anticipated match will take place in Minneapolis and air on ESPN App domestically and Netflix internationally.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio WWE and AAA Storyline Integration
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio recently pitched ideas for integrating storylines between WWE and AAA, suggesting cross-promotional matches and title opportunities involving The Judgment Day, Omos, and Dorian Roldan. During an appearance on The Ariel Helwani Show, Mysterio expressed enthusiasm about bringing fresh creative ideas to both companies and questioned why such collaborations haven't already been explored.

stories.title: Becky Lynch Women's Division Commentary
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch expressed her pride in WWE's women's division during an interview with The Female Quotient, highlighting how women have achieved major milestones like main eventing WrestleMania and competing for mid-card titles. Lynch emphasized her optimism about the division's future, stating that when she considers who WWE's biggest stars will be in coming years, she primarily envisions women rather than men in those main event roles.

stories.title: Zoey Stark WWE Release and Support from Fellow Stars
stories.tldr: Stark has named specific WWE stars who supported her through her release and recovery, including Becky Lynch, CM Punk, and Cody Rhodes. Lynch was among the first to reach out and continues helping her today, while Punk supported her throughout her entire rehab journey and Rhodes provided detailed guidance on her post-WWE plans. Stark emphasized the importance of acknowledging these friendships and the good hearts of people in the industry.

stories.title: Nick Aldis WWE In-Ring Debut
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy believes Nick Aldis' SummerSlam match against Gunther will be a one-time special attraction rather than the start of a full-time wrestling return. Hardy predicts Gunther will win and expects Aldis to return to his role as SmackDown General Manager afterward, citing that Aldis' strength lies in his authority figure position rather than as an active competitor.

stories.title: WWE Dragon Lee Injury Update
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee revealed he suffered a torn thumb during his recent Raw match against Rusev and Ethan Page. While x-rays initially came back clear, an MRI confirmed the tear. Lee is hoping to continue wrestling rather than undergo surgery, which would sideline him for three to four months.

stories.title: ROH Death Before Dishonor 2026
stories.tldr: Ring of Honor has announced a major card for Death Before Dishonor 2026 on August 21 at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, featuring five championship matches including Nigel McGuinness facing Lee Moriarty in a retirement stipulation match for the ROH Pure Championship, Bandido defending the ROH World Championship against Nick Wayne, Athena putting her historic Women's World Championship on the line against Hazuki, and Deonna Purrazzo defending the Women's Pure Championship against Steph De Lander.

stories.title: Jushin Liger Independent Wrestling Appearance
stories.tldr: Jushin "Thunder" Liger made a surprise appearance at F1RST Wrestling's event at Mall of America on July 31, 2026, winning the Rumble at the Rotunda match. The legendary wrestler, who famously appeared at the same venue during WCW Nitro's debut in 1995, has been sporadically returning to action since his retirement in 2020. Liger is currently in Minnesota as part of WrestleCon activities during SummerSlam weekend.

stories.title: NJPW and WWE Competition Analysis
stories.tldr: Former NJPW owner Takaaki Kidani revealed that WWE's massive $5 billion, 10-year Netflix deal in January 2024 was the decisive factor convincing him that Bushiroad could no longer compete independently in the global wrestling business. Multiple challenges including AEW's launch, the COVID-19 pandemic, and wrestler criticism had already created doubts, but the scale of WWE's Netflix agreement demonstrated that NJPW needed ownership with substantial media and streaming resources to survive at the highest level.

stories.title: Mustafa Ali and TNA Talent Scouting
stories.tldr: Mustafa Ali has earned significant backstage respect in TNA Wrestling for his efforts in talent development and scouting, informally watching independent wrestling and recommending prospects to the company. Ali's mentoring of Jason Hotch, including willingly losing the TNA International Championship to him, demonstrates his commitment to building the company's future stars despite his on-screen character's reluctance.

stories.title: NWA EMERGE 98 Event Coverage
stories.tldr: NWA star Carson Drake has been ruled out of EMERGE 98: Back In The Saddle due to an injury sustained in Philadelphia, forcing a last-minute replacement. Kellin Craven will now challenge Tre LaMar for the EMERGE Outbreak Championship on August 1 in Columbus, Indiana. Craven views this opportunity as crucial to establishing himself permanently in the promotion and plans to bring desperation to the title match.

stories.title: Title Changes on July 31st Wrestling History
stories.tldr: July 31st has been a historically significant date for professional wrestling title changes, with approximately 274 major title changes occurring on this date throughout wrestling history. Notable champions crowned on this day include Giant Baba winning the AJPW/PWF Heavyweight Title in 1984, Stan Hansen capturing the NWA International Heavyweight Title in 1986, and Lance Storm winning the WCW Cruiserweight Title in 2000.

stories.title: Matt Hardy Suggests Overexposed WWE Star Take Time Off After SummerSlam
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Matt Hardy believes Danhausen has been overexposed through constant television appearances and promotional campaigns leading up to SummerSlam. Hardy praised Danhausen's upcoming match against Dominik Mysterio but suggested WWE scale back his appearances afterward to protect his value as a commodity. He warned that overexposure could cause fans to tire of the character and turn against him.

stories.title: Maven Draws Scathing Response From WWE NXT Star Over ‘Sh*tty Acting’ Criticism
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Maven criticized Jackson Drake's acting in a recent Vanity Project segment on his YouTube channel, calling it "sh*tty acting." The 22-year-old NXT star fired back on X, claiming he has already made a bigger impact in six months than Maven did in four years with WWE, while Maven praised Drake's stablemate Myka Lockwood as a major prospect.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Famer Feared Fans Had Forgotten Her Before Surprise Return
stories.tldr: Brie Bella admitted she was nervous before her surprise return at the 2026 WWE Royal Rumble, worried that fans might have forgotten her after a four-year absence from the ring. However, the positive crowd reaction immediately alleviated her concerns and reminded her of the strong connection she and her sister Nikki have maintained with their fanbase over the years.

stories.title: AEW's Jeff Jarrett Looks Back On Original Intention For Bullet Club Membership
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett recently reflected on his brief stint as a member of the Bullet Club, recalling how he was brought in as the "office member" of the influential stable from August 2024 through January 2015 under AJ Styles' leadership. The Hall of Famer expressed amazement at the unexpected opportunity and the group's massive popularity at the time. To commemorate his membership, Jarrett is now auctioning off his personally signed Bullet Club tracksuit through Heritage Auctions starting July 31.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio Explains Why His Wife Has No Issue With Liv Morgan Storyline
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio explained during an interview that open communication with his wife, Marie Juliette, prevents his on-screen WWE storyline with Liv Morgan from causing problems in their personal relationship. Marie is informed in advance about potentially uncomfortable segments and occasionally watches them before offering feedback on his performance. Dominik also confirmed that his sister Aalyah is joining WWE.

stories.title: ESPN Laid Off Combat Sports Reporter Andreas Hale In Company-Wide Cuts
stories.tldr: ESPN laid off combat sports reporter Andreas Hale as part of company-wide reductions connected to the integration of NFL Network assets. Hale had covered professional wrestling, boxing and mixed martial arts for the network, but his tenure included controversy over his WWE coverage. While the exact reasons for his departure remain unclear, there is no established connection between his previous credential denial and grading disputes with WWE and his layoff.

stories.title: What Could Have Been: What If Finn Balor Hadn't Gotten Injured At WWE SummerSlam 2016?
stories.tldr: Finn Balor's shoulder injury at SummerSlam 2016 during his Universal Championship-winning match against Seth Rollins derailed what could have been a dominant main event career on WWE Raw. Had he remained healthy, Balor likely would have held the Universal Championship for an extended period and walked into WrestleMania 33 as champion, potentially establishing himself as a reliable main event player instead of struggling in the mid-card for years after his return.

stories.title: WWE Star Says Heel Turn Was ‘Ruined’ By Another Star’s Return
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella has joked that her sister Brie's return to WWE at the 2026 Royal Rumble "ruined" her heel turn, which she had been actively requesting. The sisters were repositioned as babyfaces upon Brie's return, ending Nikki's heel run just as she was gaining momentum and receiving positive feedback from fans and colleagues for her villainous character work.

stories.title: The Undertaker Absent From Recent WWE AAA Event, Replacement Revealed
stories.tldr: The Undertaker missed WWE's recent AAA event on July 25 due to a family commitment, with Jeremy Borash taking over creative duties for the Verano De Escandalo show. Since WWE's takeover of AAA in April 2025, The Undertaker and Borash have been instrumental in reshaping the Mexican promotion's creative direction, earning praise from top talent like Dominik Mysterio and Chad Gable.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling News and Updates
stories.tldr: Road Dogg's negotiations with TNA have stalled since June's Slammiversary, with the two sides no longer appearing close to a deal. Meanwhile, Mara Sade remains unsigned but continues competing in TNA's TV Championship tournament. Mustafa Ali received praise for his International Championship match and is informally scouting talent for the company.

stories.title: Lash Legend Beats Giulia, Earns Last Spot In SummerSlam Ladder Match On WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: Lash Legend defeated Giulia on SmackDown to secure the final spot in Sunday's interim WWE Women's Championship ladder match at SummerSlam. Legend will join Tiffany Stratton, Jade Cargill, Charlotte Flair, and Chelsea Green in the match. The interim title was created after Rhea Ripley was deemed too injured to defend her championship at the event.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns Sign with AEW
stories.tldr: Motor City Machine Guns Chris Sabin and Alex Shelley made a surprise debut on AEW Collision in their hometown of Detroit on July 30, 2026, officially announcing they had signed with the company. The signing comes after their WWE release in April 2026 and the completion of their 90-day non-compete clause. AEW President Tony Khan confirmed the signing on social media, and the duo later assisted the Bang Bang Gang in a post-match angle against the Death Riders and The Dogs.

stories.title: AEW Continental Cup Tournament
stories.tldr: AEW announced a brand-new 16-man Continental Cup tournament on the July 30 episode of Collision, debuting next week and concluding at All In London on August 30. The tournament will feature random draws inspired by England's FA Cup, with the winner claiming both the Continental Cup trophy and the AEW Continental Championship. Commentator Nigel McGuinness announced his participation, joining confirmed competitors Jon Moxley, Orange Cassidy, Kyle O'Reilly, and Roderick Strong.

stories.title: Jim Ross AEW & Tony Khan
stories.tldr: Jim Ross praised AEW President Tony Khan as "a blessing in my life" while discussing his health challenges and upcoming brain surgery scheduled for August. The legendary broadcaster expressed gratitude for Khan's support during his health battles and hopes to return to work at AEW All In in London following the procedure. Ross's current AEW contract expires in August, continuing a pattern of short-term deal renewals.

stories.title: AEW MyAEW Streaming Expansion
stories.tldr: AEW has announced that six new independent wrestling promotions from around the world have joined the MyAEW streaming service, significantly expanding its content library. The additions include major European promotions RevPro and wXw, women's wrestling company Pro Wrestling Eve, and several U.S.-based indies. The expansion sets the stage for a packed August schedule culminating in AEW All In: London on August 30.

stories.title: Charlotte Flair & Danhausen AEW Connection
stories.tldr: Charlotte Flair has praised Danhausen for helping her showcase a more fun and energetic side of her personality, expressing interest in teaming with the popular character in WWE. The 14-time World Champion is now pursuing her 15th title win in a Five-way ladder match for the Interim WWE Women's Championship, emphasizing how consistency and perseverance can lead to breaking records regardless of age or industry challenges.

stories.title: Tony Khan Detroit AEW Dynamite Announcement
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan announced to the live Detroit crowd after the July 29 Dynamite broadcast that he wants to bring a pay-per-view to Little Caesars Arena, asking fans to contact the venue about securing a weekend date. The announcement came after multiple PPV chants during the show, and Khan had previously appeared on stage with Insane Clown Posse before the taping. AEW is returning to the same venue for a special Thursday night episode of Collision on July 30.

stories.title: Will Ospreay AEW Grand Slam Mexico
stories.tldr: Ospreay's match against Mark Davis at AEW Grand Slam Mexico has been upgraded to a Mexico City Street Fight after a brutal post-match attack on Collision. Ospreay also discussed his value to Tony Khan, crediting his five-star matches with helping secure his AEW contract.

stories.title: AEW Grand Slam Mexico Matches & Card Updates
stories.tldr: AEW significantly upgraded the Grand Slam Mexico card on Collision with major additions including a Trios title defense, Hangman Page's return to in-ring competition, and the stipulation change for Ospreay vs. Davis to a Mexico City street fight. The show has grown into a stacked 2.5-hour event featuring multiple championship matches and high-profile international talent.

stories.title: Tony Khan Addresses AEW Roster Size & WWE Signings
stories.tldr: Khan elaborated on AEW's new PPV strategy, moving start times up by one hour to ensure East Coast broadcasts end before midnight while maintaining reasonable West Coast times. The earlier start time proved successful at the recent Redemption event in Montreal. Khan stressed the difficulty of accommodating all available free agents given the competitive landscape for TV and PPV spots on both Dynamite and Collision.

stories.title: WWE Baffled by Tony Khan AEW Booking
stories.tldr: WWE officials remain interested in signing Persephone if her AEW deal expires, viewing her star potential as being wasted in her current role. The comparison to Stephanie Vaquer—who WWE rapidly elevated after her AEW run—suggests Khan's reluctance to feature Persephone prominently may backfire when her contract becomes available.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Notes & Appearances
stories.tldr: ICP made their on-screen debut Thursday on Collision, participating in an Ice Bucket Challenge with Rhino to raise ALS awareness funds. The segment built momentum for the Rebel Heart tribute Dynamite on September 9, with Britt Baker recently visiting longtime AEW worker Rebel (Tanea Brooks), who was diagnosed with ALS earlier this year. One hundred percent of Rebel Heart merchandise proceeds will go to the I Am ALS Foundation.

stories.title: The New Day AEW All In London 2026
stories.tldr: Following their July 29 "Daybreak" video, Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods are now expected to debut at AEW All In London 2026, where they could align with Swerve Strickland, reunite with The Hurt Syndicate, enter a Tag Team Casino Gauntlet, confront returning FTR, or interfere in the AEW World Tag Team Championship match between Cage and Cope versus The Young Bucks.

stories.title: AEW Willow Nightingale vs Mercedes Moné
stories.tldr: Willow Nightingale will defend her AEW Women's World Championship against Mercedes Mone at All In London 2026 after signing the contract on the July 29 episode of Dynamite. However, the match was originally planned with the roles reversed, with Mone supposed to be champion heading into the bout. Tony Khan reportedly restructured his plans to ensure he could still deliver this particular matchup.

stories.title: ICP ALS Challenge AEW Collision
stories.tldr: During AEW Collision on July 30, Insane Clown Posse and former WWE star Rhino participated in an ALS Ice Bucket Challenge to support Rebel's fight against the disease. The segment featured Violent J paying tribute to ECW legend Sabu and resulted in The Conglomeration members getting drenched by ice water in front of their Detroit hometown crowd.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam Talent & Match Updates
stories.tldr: WWE SummerSlam 2026 is shaping up with multiple storyline developments as the two-night event approaches in Minneapolis. Key updates include Solo Sikoa receiving significant backstage praise for his babyface work with potential for an extended character run, Grayson Waller's controversial return to NXT sparking mockery from fellow roster members, and various wrestlers discussing their career aspirations and character developments heading into the premium live event.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown July 31 Go-Home Episode
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown on July 31, 2026, will air live from the Resch Center in Green Bay, Wisconsin at 8 PM ET as the go-home show before SummerSlam. The card features a highly anticipated face-to-face confrontation between Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk and challenger Cody Rhodes, a WWE Tag Team Championship defense by Damian Priest and R-Truth against The War Raiders, and the final Interim Women's Championship Ladder Match Qualifier between Giulia and Lash Legend. NFL star Micah Parsons will attend the event.

stories.title: Vince Russo Triple H WWE Creative Criticism
stories.tldr: Vince Russo, the former WWE head writer, harshly criticized Triple H's creative direction during an appearance on Talk is Jericho, calling it "the worst creative in the history of WWE" and worse than previous eras. Russo suggested that Triple H's political maneuvering is preventing the company from hearing outside perspectives that could help improve the product, though he acknowledged Triple H would likely never consider his input.

stories.title: Logan Paul WWE vs AEW Crossover
stories.tldr: WWE's Logan Paul and AEW's Big BOOM AJ met at the National Sports Collectors Convention in Chicago where they participated in an impromptu "Boom-Off" competition. The two social media-turned-wrestlers engaged in a playful 30-second contest to see who could shout "boom" with more energy and conviction. Big BOOM AJ ultimately emerged victorious, and the lighthearted crossover moment between the rival wrestling promotions went viral on social media.

stories.title: WWE Trademarks & Filings
stories.tldr: WWE has filed multiple new trademark applications with the USPTO, including AWA for merchandise and toys, along with three video game-related titles: WWE Lock It In, WWE Championship Gold, and WWE Scratchcard. The filings also include wrestler ring names Cruz Montana and Alix Brooks, as well as WWE Radio. The AWA trademark is particularly notable as WWE previously held and abandoned a similar trademark from 2010 to 2014.

stories.title: WWE EVOLVE Talent Steps Away
stories.tldr: Cyrus Habibi-Likio, a WWE EVOLVE talent and former college football player, has announced his departure from WWE after less than a year with the promotion. His decision to step away was motivated by his wife's pregnancy with their third child, proximity to family in California, the ability to focus on his real estate business, and strengthening his faith and church community involvement. Despite leaving, Habibi-Likio expressed gratitude toward WWE and left open the possibility of returning to wrestling in the future.

stories.title: Mickie James ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
stories.tldr: WWE legend Mickie James has launched an Ice Bucket Challenge fundraiser to support her friend Rebel, who is battling terminal ALS. Fans can donate $5 per raffle entry for the chance to dump ice on James live at WrestleCon Minneapolis on August 2, with 100 percent of proceeds benefiting I AM ALS, a patient-led organization dedicated to ALS research and support.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026 Preview & Coverage
stories.tldr: ESPN is introducing a new "Moment of the Night" championship belt at SummerSlam that will be awarded to the most impactful performance each night. CM Punk predicts his rivalry with Cody Rhodes will extend far beyond their SummerSlam title match, while creative remains divided on the Women's Ladder Match and Balor vs. Zayn.

stories.title: Royce Keys WWE Run
stories.tldr: Keys revealed that Triple H personally had his eye on him during WrestleMania week, viewing his SummerSlam spot as validation that WWE trusts him. He also opened up about his 14-year friendship with Jacob Fatu, acknowledging they have a deep history together despite now being on opposing sides at the pay-per-view.

stories.title: WWE Creative Pressure After Raw July 27
stories.tldr: The July 27 RAW episode's poor 2.73 Cagematch rating has triggered internal pressure at WWE, intensified by Netflix executives attending the show. Backstage scrutiny has focused on the opening segment's technical issues and Femi's botched finish, while creative staff reportedly questioned the decision to feature Ryan Garcia despite his recent controversies.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa WWE Babyface Run
stories.tldr: WWE's initial plan was to keep Solo Sikoa's babyface run temporary, but positive crowd reactions have sparked internal discussions about extending it indefinitely. Backstage sources reveal creative and fellow talent have long known about his charisma and humor, traits that were previously hidden during his silent Bloodline tenure.

stories.title: TNA Lockdown PPV Card Announcements
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling announced multiple matches for its Lockdown pay-per-view on August 23 in Chicago, with all bouts taking place inside steel cages. The card includes title defenses from The Hardys (Tag Team Champions), Cedric Alexander (X-Division Champion), and the Knockouts World Tag Team Champions, plus a grudge match between AJ Francis and Elijah.

stories.title: AAA Triplemania 34 Venue Change
stories.tldr: WWE announced that AAA TripleMania 34's Night One, originally scheduled for the Luxor in Las Vegas on September 11, has been moved to the larger MGM Grand Garden Arena due to unprecedented demand. The previously sold-out event will maintain its original date and start time, with existing ticket holders receiving information about transfers and new tickets going on sale August 4.

stories.title: TNA Amateur Wrestling Partnership
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has partnered with :30 Second Takedown, a new amateur wrestling tournament created by Rich Christensen (creator of the motorsports series PINKS), featuring 32 elite amateur wrestlers competing in 30-second matches. The tournament will air on TNA+ immediately after TNA Bound For Glory on October 11, 2026, and will be filmed in Iowa with matches determined by randomly drawn cards.

stories.title: TAKAYAMANIA EMPIRE V Matches
stories.tldr: TAKAYAMANIA EMPIRE V, the annual benefit show for paralyzed former wrestler Yoshihiro Takayama, continues to build its card with two newly announced matches. The September 7th event at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo will feature Hideki Suzuki vs. Danshoku Dieno and a tag team match with Chihiro Hashimoto and Ryo Mizunami facing Hiroyo Matsumoto and Miyu Yamashita. The show will also feature several wrestling legends as special guests.

stories.title: TNA Roster Teases & Departures
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling blurred the lines between storyline and reality on the July 30 episode of iMPACT when Daria Rae teased releasing Harley Hudson from the company due to her recent losing streak. The segment featured Santino Marella defending Hudson by highlighting her commitment to the promotion, while Rae insisted that performance matters most and threatened to take the issue to TNA's Board of Directors. Hudson's struggles have been compounded by recent losses, including her tag team partner Myla Grace receiving her release and Hudson's first-round elimination from the Knockouts Television Championship tournament at the hands of WWE NXT star Thea Hail.

stories.title: TNA Knockouts Title Matches
stories.tldr: Wendy Choo, formerly of WWE, will challenge Xia Brookside for the TNA Knockouts World Championship on the August 6th episode of Thursday Night iMPACT. The show will also feature Matt Hardy facing Ryan Nemeth, and the Knockouts Television Title Tournament match between Heather by Elegance and Mara Sadè, though Sadè's status remains uncertain following her contract expiration.

stories.title: Marigold Ring Announcer Health Update
stories.tldr: Marigold ring announcer Oki "Okky" Okita has been diagnosed with Stage 4 colon cancer that has spread to other areas of his body. The veteran announcer, whose 30-year career spans multiple Japanese wrestling promotions, discovered the illness after noticing physical abnormalities and is currently hospitalized preparing for chemotherapy. Marigold is hosting a benefit event on August 9 to support Okita during his treatment, with the wrestling community rallying behind the respected voice.

stories.title: Dark Side of the Ring Big Bossman Episode
stories.tldr: The Big Bossman episode of Dark Side of the Ring season 7 drew 135,000 viewers and a 0.04 rating in the 18-49 demographic, marking the lowest viewership of the season. The episode aired on Tuesday, July 28 on Vice TV, underperforming compared to previous season 7 episodes which ranged from 151,000 to 180,000 viewers.

stories.title: Dark Side of the Ring Viewership & Bonus Content
stories.tldr: A wrestling journalist reviewed the classic blue steel cage match between Hulk Hogan and The Big Boss Man from Saturday Night's Main Event XXI in May 1989, where Hogan successfully defended his WWF Championship despite interference from Big Boss Man's manager Slick and the surprise appearance of Zeus. The match featured the typical Hulk Hogan formula with the signature hulking up sequence and dramatic near-escapes, ultimately won when Hogan handcuffed Big Boss Man to the cage door and escaped over the top. This was the first of three unsuccessful WWF Championship matches for Big Boss Man, with his other title shots coming against The Rock and The Big Show.

stories.title: NJPW Drilla Moloney PRODUCE Wrestling Deal
stories.tldr: NJPW's Drilla Moloney has signed a multi-fight deal with PRODUCE Wrestling that will see him perform at least five shows through the end of 2026, with his debut scheduled for September 13th at White Eagle Hall in Jersey City. The current PROGRESS Wrestling Tag Team Champion and two-time IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Champion joins a promotion that features an impressive roster of international wrestling talent.

stories.title: Title Changes Wrestling History July 30
stories.tldr: July 30th has seen 214 major professional wrestling title changes throughout history, making it a moderately significant date in the sport. Notable champions crowned on this date include Stan Hansen winning the AJPW/PWF Heavyweight Title in 1985, Booker T capturing the WCW World Heavyweight Title in 2001, Mick Foley winning the TNA Legends Title in 2009, and Takashi Sugiura claiming the GHC Heavyweight Title in 2016.

stories.title: Caleb Konley Interview
stories.tldr: Caleb Konley, a 21-year veteran wrestler and lifelong Insane Clown Posse fan, discussed his journey as JCW Lunacy Heavyweight Champion in an interview with Arizona James Walsh. Konley revealed how his passion for Juggalo culture since age 14 has finally merged with his wrestling career, and he praised ICP's collaborative creative approach and commitment to delivering Attitude Era-style "crash TV" wrestling.

stories.title: International Fight Week Arena Mexico
stories.tldr: International Fight Week is taking place at Arena Mexico from August 4-7, 2026, featuring major title matches across AEW, ROH, and NJPW. The week includes a CMLL show on Tuesday with multiple championship bouts, AEW Grand Slam on Wednesday, and the CMLL International Grand Prix on Friday, bringing together talent from wrestling promotions worldwide.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth TNA Roster Updates
stories.tldr: Nic Nemeth argues that media attention on TNA Wrestling's recent departures has overshadowed the company's simultaneous roster additions and internal development efforts. Nemeth highlighted several emerging talents and returning acts that he believes demonstrate TNA's strength, suggesting the company may actually have gained more wrestlers than it lost and comparing how WWE roster changes receive less scrutiny than TNA's smaller-scale exits.

stories.title: Summer Slam 2024:Almost Lost In Cleveland
stories.tldr: A wrestling news editor recounts his experience traveling to SummerSlam 2024 in Cleveland, drawing parallels to the infamous "Lost in Cleveland" storyline from WCW's past. After previously attending SummerSlam 2023 in Detroit with wrestling content producer Mike Sorg, the editor agreed to make the shorter trip to Cleveland with Pat MacLaughlin, alongside other wrestling events happening that weekend including Game Changer Wrestling and WrestleCon.

stories.title: GUNTHER Reveals Why He Never Formed Another Faction After Imperium
stories.tldr: GUNTHER has revealed he has no plans to form another faction following Imperium's dissolution, explaining that successful stables must develop naturally rather than being forced together for creative purposes. The Ring General prefers operating as a solo competitor, a role he's been comfortable with throughout most of his career, and believes adding allies wouldn't benefit his current position in WWE.

stories.title: Brie Bella Explains How Bryan Danielson Made Her WWE Return Possible
stories.tldr: Brie Bella credits her husband Bryan Danielson's retirement from full-time wrestling with making her WWE return possible, as his transition to being the primary parent at home allowed her to resume her in-ring career. Danielson has thrived in his new domestic role, even improving their children's academic performance in reading and math. Brie will compete in a six-woman tag team match at SummerSlam alongside Paige and her sister Nikki Bella.

stories.title: TNA Impact Championship Changes & Tournament Updates
stories.tldr: Internal Order 4 drama erupted during Hotch's championship victory as multiple faction members interfered in different ways, with Tasha Steelz preventing Ali from cheating and Mila Moore subsequently attacking her. Additionally, TNA is considering terminating Harley Hudson's contract due to her recent loss streak, while actress Aimee Garcia made a surprise appearance ringside.

stories.title: TNA Honors Rebel/Tanea Brooks for ALS
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling paid on-air tribute to Rebel during the July 30 episode of iMPACT, with commentators Tom Hannifan and Matthew Rehwoldt delivering a message of support on behalf of the company. The tribute recognized Brooks' two separate runs with TNA between 2013-2018 and acknowledged her as a valued member of the TNA family. The gesture adds to wrestling's broader show of solidarity as Brooks continues her ALS battle.

stories.title: AJ Styles Recalls Backstage Atmosphere Before & After Final WWE Match
stories.tldr: AJ Styles opened up about the emotional moments immediately following his retirement match against GUNTHER at the 2026 Royal Rumble, describing how the entire roster greeted him backstage and how he needed a private moment to process the finality of his in-ring career. The veteran wrestler found solace in a quiet locker room before returning to accept support from colleagues like Shane Helms.
